basics.name: Anas Uddin
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary:
Hi, I'm Anas Uddin, a software engineer and MSc Data Science (minor in Software, Web & Cloud Technologies) student at Tampere University. I'm passionate about building elegant, scalable, and meaningful digital solutions. Over the past four years, I've worked on enterprise-level projects for clients in Finland and Japan, delivering high-performing, maintainable systems using Java, Spring Boot, Angular, and modern web technologies.

Alongside my studies, I currently work as a Research Assistant at Tampere University, where I contribute to research in database systems and data-driven computing.

Beyond code, I'm deeply interested in design, aesthetics, and how technology can blend function with form, whether it's crafting clean architectures, intuitive interfaces, or visually balanced experiences. My approach to software engineering is driven by problem-solving, precision, and continuous learning, from debugging legacy systems to optimizing data-driven solutions.

I'm now expanding my expertise at the intersection of software engineering and data science, aiming to create intelligent, human-centered systems that not only work efficiently but also feel intuitively right.

work.name: Tampere University
work.summary:
Research Assistant in the SECHA (Scaling EV Charging Solutions for New Values and Services in Collaboration Networks) project, a €4M Business Finland Co-Innovation initiative coordinated by Tampere University in collaboration with VTT and LUT University. The project focuses on enabling scalable, intelligent, and interoperable EV charging ecosystems by integrating heterogeneous data sources across industrial and grid partners.

My work focuses on EV charging data interoperability, where I contribute to designing and prototyping data integration frameworks that unify diverse partner systems into a coherent, scalable data platform. The role combines applied research and systems engineering, with an emphasis on energy-efficient data management, interoperability standards, and real-world data pipeline design within smart energy ecosystems.

IG Takeover: First Week vs Now at TAU
On Tampere University's official Instagram

I recently had the opportunity to take over the official Instagram account of Tampere University for one day, where I managed live content creation and audience engagement for the university's social media community.

During the takeover, I created and shared real-time Instagram Stories highlighting campus life, student experiences, and everyday moments at the university. I also actively engaged with followers by responding to questions about studies, student life, accommodation, and adjusting to life in Finland.

This experience allowed me to strengthen my skills in digital communication, content storytelling, and community engagement in a real-world setting. It was a valuable opportunity to connect with an international student audience, represent the university's voice, and create meaningful interactions through social media.

Blog Post: Learning the Finnish Way, One Awkward Moment at a Time

projects.name: EduChat: Smart AI Tutor
projects.description:
EduChat is an AI enhanced learning support system integrated into Tampere University's Plussa LMS. It combines a Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline with an on premises Large Language Model (LLM) to deliver context aware assistance, conversational learning exercises and teacher oriented analytics.

Our team continued development on top of the existing EduChat codebase and delivered several major features during the Spring 2026 iteration. These included an improved Chat Exercise configuration workflow, the EduLens teacher dashboard with keyword analytics, public channel engagement metrics, a notification and email workflow, multi format file support, and multiple usability improvements across the system.

The project followed Scrum with six development sprints and a dedicated QA sprint. We expanded the automated test suite to around 500 test cases, improved frontend and backend stability, and ensured full integration with Plussa through LTI based authentication. The final system was deployed in the TUNI environment and validated through customer sprint reviews.

Team size: 6
My role: Test Manager responsible for test strategy, automated testing, documentation and feature development for public chat usability.
highlights: Built with: React, TypeScript, Vite, Material UI, Chart.js, Recharts, Django, Python, Django REST Framework, Django Channels, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Docker, Docker Compose, GitLab, VS Code, Postman, Thunder Client, Jest, React Testing Library, Django Test Framework, ESLint, Prettier, flake8, pylint, TUNI on premises LLM service, LTI authentication, Plussa LMS infrastructure
